description:
Update one of this shop's listings: its title, text, price, district, condition, photos or a job's salary.

Send its id and only the fields to change; the rest stay as they are, and changes are saved at once. Photos you send replace the whole set. A refused edit changes nothing and returns its reason code, such as `title_too_short` or `invalid_price`. It cannot change a subcategory or the licence values, nor the category or the status (use set_listing_status for that).

Returns `held` and `unpublished`, which say when the saved edit is not public yet (`held: true` while the listing waits for eno's licence check), and `listing` as it now stands: `id`, `title`, `description`, `price`, `priceUnit`, `district`, `condition`, `images`, `status`, `verified`, `url` and the rest of get_listing's fields.

condition.description: The item's condition in words. Send an empty string to clear it, or leave it out to keep it

description.description: The new text for the listing page; contact details are not allowed in it, and it is cut at 5,000 characters. Leave it out to keep the current text

district.description: Where the item is, as a district or area. Send an empty string to clear it, or leave it out to keep it

id.description: The listing to change: its id (such as `cmh0q2x8f0001...`), from list_listings or create_listing

images.description: The complete new set of photo URLs, in display order; it replaces the current photos. To add one, send the current `images` from get_listing plus the new URL. Leave it out to keep them

price.description: The new asking price in VND (for a job: its monthly salary in VND). Leave it out to keep the current price

salaryM.description: A job's monthly salary in whole millions of VND (25 = 25.000.000 đ); it wins over `price`. Send null to remove it, or leave it out to keep it

title.description: The new headline; phone numbers are not allowed in it, and it is cut at 140 characters. Leave it out to keep the current one

name: update_listing

held.description: true when the edit is saved but the listing stays unpublished until eno's licence check approves it; false otherwise

category.description: The category it is filed under

slug.description: The category slug, as create_listing takes it

city.description: Its city or province, e.g. "Hồ Chí Minh"

condition.description: The item's condition in words, e.g. "like new"; null when none was given

contactCount.description: Leads, all time: how many different signed-in buyers opened the seller's contact from it

description.description: The text on the listing page; an empty string when the seller wrote none

district.description: Its district or area; null when none was given

id.description: The listing id (such as `cmh0q2x8f0001...`); pass it to get_listing, update_listing, set_listing_status or delete_listing

images.description: Photo URLs in display order. To keep them through an edit, send this list back to update_listing

listingType.description: What the listing offers, e.g. "sell", "rent", "job" or "wanted"

location.description: The place as shown on the listing page, for display; use district and city to compare or filter listings

negotiable.description: Whether buyers may send offers below the price; always false for a job or a wanted ad

postedAt.description: When it was listed, as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp

price.description: The asking price in Vietnamese đồng (VND); for a job, its monthly salary in VND. Show it with priceUnit, formatted as VND (e.g. 12.000.000 đ)

priceUnit.description: What the price is for, e.g. "VND" or "VND/month"; show it beside the price

status.description: active: on sale (public once verified). sold: kept on the site, marked sold. hidden: off the site but not deleted; set_listing_status moves a listing between these three. Any other value, such as expired or stale, means eno took the listing off the site

subcategorySlug.description: Its subcategory; null when it has none

title.description: The headline buyers see in search and on the listing page

url.description: Its page on eno; share it with buyers once the listing is public

verified.description: false while the listing waits for eno's check and is not public yet; true once eno has published it

video.description: The listing's video as a full URL; null when it has none

views.description: How many times its page has been viewed since it was listed, all time

listing.description: The listing as it now stands, the same fields get_listing returns; null only if it could not be read back

unpublished.description: true when the listing belongs to an account whose listings are not shown publicly; false otherwise

title: Update marketplace listing
